column1: # The full (n,t) sweep. Columns: n, t, tsslib_mode.
# tsslib_mode is fixtures|live. tss-lib ships precomputed keygen fixtures for
# exactly (n=5,t=2); that row uses them (setup/keygen serialize as null — see
# SCHEMA.md caveat 8) and every other row runs live keygen for real numbers.
# tr-ecdsa has no such distinction: the mode column is ignored for it, and each
# row is run once per security level in --levels.
# See orchestrator/smoke-grid.tsv for the 2-row subset used for fast
# end-to-end checks before committing to a full run.
